title: MVP-01a: Wire form submission to GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch
body:
Wire the static survey form (src/app.js) to submit to GitHub Actions via workflow_dispatch instead of localStorage.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Form submission POSTs to GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch endpoint with JSON payload
- topics.json is updated in repo with new submission (validated via workflow)
- User sees success/error feedback in UI
- No localStorage fallback remains

**Technical Details:**
- GitHub Actions workflow: .github/workflows/survey-handler.yml (already exists)
- Need GitHub token with repo scope stored as secret
- Frontend needs to call GitHub API: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/survey-handler.yml/dispatches
- Payload: { "ref": "main", "inputs": { "topic": "...", "email": "...", "categories": [...] } }

**Dependencies:** None (P0 start)

title: MVP-03: Configure GitHub Pages deployment
body:
Configure GitHub Pages deployment for the MakeSense repository.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- GitHub Pages enabled in repo settings (source: main branch, /docs or root)
- Site accessible at https://<org>.github.io/MakeSense/
- Custom domain optional but documented
- Build process (if any) runs via GitHub Actions
- Survey form works end-to-end on deployed site

**Technical Details:**
- Repo: MakeSense (verify org)
- Settings → Pages → Source: Deploy from branch → main → /(root) or /docs
- If build needed: add deploy workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml)
- Verify CORS/HTTPS for form submission from Pages domain

**Dependencies:** None (P0 parallel)

title: MVP-02a: Integrate DGX Spark LLM into content generation
body:
Integrate DGX Spark (Ornith-1.5-35B) LLM into the content generation pipeline.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- generate-content.py calls DGX Spark endpoint (http://100.72.85.102:8000/v1) via OpenAI-compatible API
- Model generates structured educational content (not placeholder)
- Output includes: lessons, exercises, code examples, summary
- Error handling for DGX unavailable → fallback to nvidia API (Nemotron)

**Technical Details:**
- Endpoint: http://100.72.85.102:8000/v1 (Ornith-1.5-35B)
- Fallback: nvidia API (Nemotron-3-ultra) via nvidia provider
- Use openai Python client with base_url override
- Prompt template in scripts/prompts/content-generation.md
- Input: topic from topics.json
- Output: structured markdown to generated-content/{topic-slug}/content.md

**Dependencies:** DGX Spark availability confirmed (MVP-SCOPE open question #5)

title: MVP-05: Content review gate via PR
body:
Implement PR-based content review gate in the content generation workflow.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Generated content saved to staging/ branch or staging/ folder (not generated-content/)
- Workflow opens PR from staging → main with generated content
- PR includes: topic, generated content preview, generation metadata
- Human reviewer approves PR → content merged to generated-content/ → published
- Rejected PR → content discarded, user notified

**Technical Details:**
- GitHub Actions: content-generator.yml creates PR via gh pr create
- Base branch: main, head branch: staging/{topic-slug}-{timestamp}
- PR template with review checklist
- Auto-assign product owner / content engineer as reviewers
- On merge: workflow triggers Pages deploy

**Dependencies:** MVP-02a (LLM generation), MVP-03 (Pages deploy)

title: MVP-04: Email notifications on content ready
body:
Implement email notifications when content generation completes and passes review.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- On PR merge (content approved), email sent to submitted email address
- Email includes: topic, link to published content, generation timestamp
- Email provider: Resend (simpler API) or SendGrid (configured via GitHub secrets)
- Handle missing email gracefully (log only, no failure)
- Email template in repo (templates/email-content-ready.html)

**Technical Details:**
- GitHub secret: RESEND_API_KEY or SENDGRID_API_KEY
- Workflow step after PR merge: send email via provider API
- Payload: { to: email, subject: "Your MakeSense content is ready", html: template }
- Template variables: {{topic}}, {{content_url}}, {{generated_at}}
- Test with real email before launch

**Dependencies:** MVP-05 (review gate), MVP-03 (Pages for content URL)

title: MVP-02b: Prompt engineering for educational content
body:
Design and validate LLM prompt templates for educational content generation.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Prompt template produces structured markdown with: learning objectives, lessons (3-5), exercises (2-3 with solutions), code examples (where applicable), summary
- Tested against 5+ diverse topics (ML, Creative, Business, Technical, Academic)
- Output quality validated: no hallucination, accurate, pedagogically sound
- Template versioned in scripts/prompts/content-generation.md

**Technical Details:**
- Use DGX Spark (Ornith) for testing
- Test topics: "Transformer Architecture", "Personal Finance Basics", "Guitar Fundamentals", "Python for Data Science", "Creative Writing Techniques"
- Metrics: structure adherence, factual accuracy, pedagogical value
- Document prompt engineering decisions

**Dependencies:** MVP-02a (LLM integration must work first)

title: MVP-09: Schema validation for topics.json in workflow
body:
Add JSON Schema validation for topics.json in the survey-handler workflow.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- JSON Schema defined for topic submission (topic, email, categories, timestamp, source)
- Workflow validates incoming payload against schema before committing
- Invalid submissions rejected with clear error message returned to user
- Schema stored in repo (e.g., schemas/topic-submission.json)

**Technical Details:**
- Schema fields: topic (string, required, max 200), email (string, format email, optional), categories (array of strings, optional), timestamp (ISO8601, auto-generated), source (string, enum: web|api)
- Use jq or Python jsonschema in workflow step
- Fail workflow with descriptive error if validation fails

**Dependencies:** MVP-01a (form submission must work first)

title: MVP-10: Rate limiting & honeypot abuse protection
body:
Implement rate limiting and abuse protection for the survey form submission.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Max 5 submissions/hour per IP address
- Honeypot field in form (hidden field that bots fill but humans don't)
- Submissions exceeding limit return 429 with retry-after header
- Honeypot submissions silently dropped (no error to user, no workflow trigger)

**Technical Details:**
- Rate limiting: can use GitHub Actions built-in concurrency or external store (Redis/Cloudflare KV if available)
- For MVP: implement in workflow using file-based counter in repo (commits as counter) or GitHub API rate limit
- Honeypot: add hidden input field `website_url` in form, check in workflow - if filled, exit 0 silently
- Frontend: add honeypot field with CSS display:none and autocomplete=off

**Dependencies:** MVP-01a (form submission), MVP-03 (Pages for frontend changes)

title: MVP-07: Content versioning (v1, v2, latest symlink)
body:
Implement content versioning - each regeneration creates versioned subfolders.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Regeneration of same topic creates v1/, v2/, v3/ subfolders under generated-content/{topic-slug}/
- Latest version symlinked as generated-content/{topic-slug}/latest → v{N}/
- Version metadata stored (timestamp, prompt hash, model used, reviewer)
- Previous versions remain accessible

**Technical Details:**
- Directory structure: generated-content/{topic-slug}/v1/content.md, v2/content.md, etc.
- Symlink: generated-content/{topic-slug}/latest → v2/
- Metadata: generated-content/{topic-slug}/v{N}/meta.json
- Workflow determines next version number from existing folders
- Symlink updated atomically on successful review/merge

**Dependencies:** MVP-05 (review gate), MVP-02a (generation)

title: MVP-06: Duplicate detection & idempotency (30-day window)
body:
Implement duplicate detection and idempotency for survey submissions.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Same email + topic combination within 30 days → updates existing submission, doesn't create duplicate
- Check topics.json for existing entry with same email + normalized topic
- If found: update timestamp, increment submission_count, trigger regeneration workflow
- If not found: create new entry as normal

**Technical Details:**
- Normalize topic: lowercase, trim, remove punctuation for comparison
- In survey-handler.yml: before commit, query topics.json for match
- Use jq/Python to check and update in-memory, then commit updated topics.json
- Regeneration: trigger content-generator workflow with same topic (will create new version via MVP-07)

**Dependencies:** MVP-01a (form submission), MVP-09 (schema validation)

title: MVP-08: Basic admin dashboard (pipeline visibility)
body:
Build a basic admin dashboard (private page) for pipeline visibility.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Accessible at /admin.html (or /admin/) with basic auth (HTTP basic or shared secret)
- Shows: pending submissions (from topics.json), generation status (running/complete/failed), content inventory (generated-content/), error rate
- Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds
- Links to GitHub Actions runs for each generation
- Mobile-responsive

**Technical Details:**
- Static HTML/JS page (no build step)
- Auth: simple shared secret in GitHub secret, checked via client-side JS (or serverless function if needed)
- Data sources: topics.json (pending), GitHub Actions API (generation status), generated-content/ index (inventory)
- GitHub Actions API: list workflow runs for content-generator.yml
- Deployed via GitHub Pages alongside main site

**Dependencies:** MVP-03 (Pages), MVP-01a (topics.json flow), MVP-02a (generation)

title: MVP-11: Content categories/tags with filtering
body:
Implement content auto-categorization and tagging system.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Topics automatically categorized (ML, Creative, Business, Technical, Academic, etc.)
- Categories displayed on site and filterable
- Category assigned during content generation based on topic analysis
- Category metadata stored in generated content frontmatter

**Technical Details:**
- Use LLM (Gemini/Nemotron) to classify topic into predefined taxonomy
- Taxonomy: ML/AI, Data Science, Programming, Creative Arts, Business/Finance, Personal Development, Academic, Other
- Add category field to topics.json schema (MVP-09)
- Add category to generated content frontmatter
- Frontend: filter buttons on content listing page

**Dependencies:** MVP-02a (LLM generation), MVP-09 (schema)

title: MVP-12: User content library (email-linked dashboard)
body:
Build user content library page showing all their requested content.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Page at /library.html accessible via email link in notification
- Shows all submissions for that email (from topics.json)
- Status per topic: pending, generating, ready, failed
- Links to generated content when ready
- Responsive design matching site theme

**Technical Details:**
- Static page with client-side JS
- Query topics.json filtered by email (hash email for privacy in URL)
- Fetch generated-content/ index for ready content
- Auth: email hash in URL param (e.g., ?user=sha256(email))
- Deployed via GitHub Pages

**Dependencies:** MVP-03 (Pages), MVP-04 (email with link), MVP-07 (versioning for content links)

title: MVP-13: Feedback loop (thumbs up/down → prompt improvement)
body:
Implement feedback loop (thumbs up/down) on generated content.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Thumbs up/down buttons on each content piece
- Feedback stored (GitHub Issues or JSON file in repo)
- Feedback fed back into generation prompts for future iterations
- Aggregate feedback visible in admin dashboard

**Technical Details:**
- Frontend: buttons on content page, POST to GitHub API (issues) or workflow_dispatch
- Storage: GitHub Issues with labels (feedback, topic-slug, up/down) or data/feedback.json
- Prompt enhancement: include recent feedback summary in generation prompt
- Admin dashboard: show feedback summary per topic

**Dependencies:** MVP-02b (prompt engineering), MVP-08 (admin dashboard)

title: MVP-14: Multi-format output (Markdown + HTML + PDF)
body:
Add multi-format export (PDF, HTML) for generated content.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Each generated content piece available as: Markdown (source), HTML (rendered), PDF (download)
- HTML: styled with site theme, responsive, printable
- PDF: generated via headless Chrome (puppeteer) or pandoc, includes all sections
- Export links on content page and in email notification

**Technical Details:**
- HTML: render markdown via marked.js client-side or pre-render in workflow
- PDF: GitHub Actions step with puppeteer or pandoc (pandoc lighter)
- Store exports in generated-content/{topic-slug}/v{N}/content.html, content.pdf
- Links in email template and content page

**Dependencies:** MVP-07 (versioning), MVP-05 (review gate)

title: MVP-15: Analytics & metrics (submissions, success rate, satisfaction)
body:
Implement basic analytics and metrics tracking.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Track: submissions/week, generation success rate, user satisfaction (from feedback), content views
- Dashboard in admin panel (MVP-08) showing key metrics
- Data stored in GitHub repo (data/analytics.json) or external (Plausible/GA if privacy-compliant)
- Weekly automated report via GitHub Actions

**Technical Details:**
- Submissions: count from topics.json commits per week
- Generation success: workflow run status (success/failure) for content-generator.yml
- Satisfaction: feedback up/down ratio from MVP-13
- Views: lightweight counter (client-side increment stored in repo via workflow_dispatch)
- Weekly report: scheduled workflow (cron: 0 9 * * 1) generating markdown report

**Dependencies:** MVP-08 (admin dashboard), MVP-13 (feedback), MVP-01a (submissions)

title: MVP: NCERT content pack integration (catalog.json → web app)
body:
Wire the existing NCERT catalog.json (packages/curriculum/catalog.json) into the web app:
1. Parse catalog.json → ContentPack format
2. Build content API: GET /api/packs/cbse-class9-math, GET /api/chapters/:id
3. Pre-generate question sets for each chapter (use existing question generation logic from gamification)
4. Serve static assets (PDFs, images) from CDN/local

Acceptance: Web app loads Chapter 1 "Number Systems" with text, LaTeX formulas, and 5 practice questions.

title: MVP: Gamification API integration (existing gamification/engine.py → FastAPI)
body:
Expose the existing gamification engine as FastAPI endpoints for the web app:
1. POST /api/events - receive user interaction events (course_start, lesson_complete, question_answer)
2. GET /api/users/{id}/profile - level, XP, skill ratings
3. GET /api/users/{id}/skills - top 10 skills with proficiency scores
4. GET /api/leaderboard - top 50 users
5. Integrate with existing event-tracker service (Redis stream)

Tech: FastAPI, asyncpg, existing gamification engine, event-tracker service.

Acceptance: Web app sends events → profile updates in real-time.

title: Web: Course Player Screen (NCERT content, LaTeX, video)
body: Build the CoursePlayerScreen component at packages/ui/src/components/course-player/CoursePlayerScreen.tsx. It should render NCERT content from catalog.json, support LaTeX math via KaTeX, and play video content. Uses Tamagui components. Integrates with @makesense/sync for progress tracking.

title: MVP: Local WatermelonDB + Yjs sync for offline progress
body:
Implement local-first data layer in web app:
1. WatermelonDB schema: sessions, mastery_nodes, sync_queue
2. Yjs CRDT for conflict-free sync
3. Background sync to gamification API when online
4. Offline indicator UI

Acceptance: Complete a lesson offline → reconnect → progress syncs to server.

title: MVP: PWA + Service Worker + Offline manifest
body:
Make the web app a true PWA:
1. next-pwa config with Workbox
2. Cache NCERT content, question sets, UI assets
3. Offline fallback page
4. Web App Manifest (icons, theme, display: standalone)
5. Background sync for pending events

Acceptance: Lighthouse PWA score >90, works offline after first visit.

title: Web: Coach Sidebar (hints, skill radar, daily challenge)
body: Build the CoachSidebar component at packages/ui/src/components/coach-sidebar/CoachSidebar.tsx. Shows hints, skill radar visualization, and daily challenge. Uses gamification data from @makesense/gamification and coach data from @makesense/coach.

title: Curriculum: Wire Python scrapers/extractors to TS entry points
body: Create TypeScript wrapper files in packages/curriculum/extractors/ and scrapers/ that call the existing Python scripts (pdf_extractor.py, video_extractor.py, ncert_discovery_agent.py, build_kg_v3.py). Each wrapper should spawn the Python process and return structured data matching the types in @makesense/types.

title: Web: Practice Quiz with Gamification
body: Build quiz components at packages/ui/src/components/content-renderer/ for practice questions. Integrate with @makesense/gamification for XP, streaks, badges. Use question types from @makesense/assessment (MCQ, SHORT_ANSWER, LONG_ANSWER, DIAGRAM).

title: Web: WatermelonDB + Yjs Offline Sync Integration
body: Wire @makesense/sync (WatermelonDB + Yjs CRDT) into the web app for offline progress tracking. Set up IndexedDB persistence, background sync to cloud API, and conflict resolution. Service Worker already configured via next-pwa.

title: mk-030: Portfolio Ingestion & Skill Extraction Pipeline
body:
Build a pipeline that accepts user portfolio (resume, LinkedIn, GitHub, project descriptions), extracts structured skills using LLM + NER, normalizes to standard skill taxonomy (ESCO/O*NET), and stores in user profile. Output: structured skill vector with proficiency levels, experience years, evidence links.

Requirements:
- Accept PDF/DOCX resume, LinkedIn URL, GitHub username, free-text project descriptions
- LLM-based skill extraction with confidence scoring
- Map to ESCO/O*NET taxonomy for standardization
- Deduplicate and merge overlapping skills
- Store in WatermelonDB user profile (offline-first)
- Sync to cloud via existing sync engine
- Anti-hallucination: every extracted skill must have source citation (resume section, GitHub repo, project description)

Assignee: gemini (research/web/content extraction)
Priority: high
Depends on: mk-015 (Content Pack Format), mk-017 (Cloud API sync)

title: mk-031: Career Path Recommendation Engine
body:
Build a recommendation engine that takes user's extracted skill vector (from mk-030) and maps to target job profiles with fit scores. Uses labor market data (O*NET, LinkedIn Insights, Naukri/Indeed APIs) to recommend roles matching user's experience level.

Requirements:
- Input: structured skill vector with proficiency levels, experience years
- Job role taxonomy: O*NET SOC codes + Indian market mappings (Naukri categories)
- Fit scoring algorithm: skill overlap, experience match, market demand, growth trajectory
- Output: ranked job profiles with fit %, skill gaps, learning path, salary bands (INR)
- Experience-level calibration: entry (0-2yr), mid (3-7yr), senior (8-15yr), lead (15+yr)
- Indian market context: tier-1/2/3 cities, remote/hybrid, startup vs enterprise
- Store recommendations in user profile, sync via existing engine

Assignee: gemini (research/labor market data)
Priority: high
Depends on: mk-030 (Portfolio Ingestion)

title: mk-032: Adaptive Skills Training Pipeline
body:
Build the training pipeline that takes user's skill gaps (from mk-031) and generates personalized learning content using makesense's content factory. Creates micro-learning modules, practice exercises, and assessments tailored to target job requirements.

Requirements:
- Input: skill gaps with priority ranking from career recommendation engine
- Content generation: leverages mk-015/016/017 (packager, cloud API) to build custom content packs
- Pedagogical design: micro-learning (5-15 min modules), spaced repetition, Bloom's taxonomy progression
- Practice: coding exercises (LeetCode-style), case studies, system design prompts, behavioral questions
- Assessment: adaptive quizzes, project-based evaluations, peer review integration
- Progress tracking: mastery nodes (mk-009), coach insights (mk-018/027), daily challenges (mk-028)
- Job-readiness certification: portfolio projects, mock interviews, reference implementations
- Offline-first: all content cached via WatermelonDB, syncs when online
- Content sources: existing curriculum pipeline (NCERT, Khan, NPTEL, MIT OCW) + industry-specific additions

Assignee: bruce (builder/coder - content generation, coach engine integration)
Priority: high
Depends on: mk-031 (Career Path Recommendation), mk-018 (Coach Engine), mk-020 (Course Player), mk-004 (ONNX Bridge)

title: mk-001: Expo app shell + Tamagui + TypeScript
body: Initialize Expo SDK 51+ project with TypeScript, Tamagui v1+, EAS Build config. Set up offline-first navigation (expo-router), theme system, and base project structure.

title: mk-002: SQLite + WatermelonDB schema (progress, mastery, coach, packs)
body: Define WatermelonDB collections: content_packs, learning_sessions, mastery_nodes, coach_state, sync_queue, user_profile. Include migrations, indices, and TypeScript types.

title: mk-003: Yjs CRDT + sync queue + background sync
body: Implement Yjs CRDT for conflict-free sync, delta queue for offline mutations, background sync when online (poll + push). Handle progress, mastery, coach state sync.

title: mk-004: ONNX Runtime bridge + model loader + quantization pipeline
body: Build React Native bridge for ONNX Runtime Mobile. Implement model loader, inference API, quantization pipeline (PyTorch → ONNX → INT4). Support Phi-3-mini, Gemma-2-2B, Whisper, Piper.

title: mk-005: Benchmark Phi-3-mini vs Gemma-2-2B on target devices (4/6/8 GB RAM)
body: Benchmark both models on device profiles: 4GB (low), 6GB (mid), 8GB (high). Measure: inference latency, memory usage, quality (perplexity on CBSE eval set), battery impact. Report with recommendations.

title: mk-006: NCERT Discovery Agent (Playwright, port from NCERT_SCRAPER)
body: Port shubham-kr2002/NCERT_SCRAPER DiscoveryAgent, Navigator, Normalizer, Manifest, StateStore. Discover Class 9-10 Math/Science textbooks in EN/HI/UR. Output catalog.json.

title: mk-007: PDF Extraction Worker (pymupdf + pdfplumber, structured schemas)
body: Implement PDF extraction worker using pymupdf (fast) + pdfplumber (tables). Output StructuredTextDocument schema per content pipeline spec. Handle NCERT textbooks, CBSE curriculum PDFs.

title: mk-008: CBSE Curriculum Parser → Competency KG (Neo4j, Learning Outcomes, prerequisites)
body: Parse CBSE curriculum PDFs (2025-26) to extract Learning Outcomes, competencies, topic hierarchy. Build Knowledge Graph in Neo4j: Subject → Unit → Chapter → LO → Prerequisites. Export for content alignment.

title: mk-009: Coach Data Model + longitudinal tracking + skill radar
body: Design coach data model: longitudinal mastery history, skill radar computation, improvement detection, adaptive challenge generation, learning plan orchestration, motivational narratives. Integrate with WatermelonDB.

title: mk-010: UI Component Library (Tamagui, offline-first patterns, coach dashboard)
body: Build Tamagui component library: course player, chat interface, progress visualizations, coach dashboard (skill radar, mastery heatmap), challenge cards, multimodal input components (voice, handwriting, camera). Offline-first patterns.

title: mk-011: DIKSHA eCAR Downloader + Parser
body: Port aneeshg-zeto/Diksha-Scraper: eCAR parsing, hierarchy.json walker, async downloader with resume. Download CBSE/NCERT Class 9-10 Math/Science eCARs.

title: mk-012: Khan Academy GraphQL Client (topic tree, exercises)
body: Build GraphQL client for Khan Academy internal API. Fetch topic trees for Math (algebra, geometry, statistics) and Science (physics, chemistry, biology). Handle cursor pagination, exercise metadata.

title: mk-013: NPTEL/SWAYAM + MIT OCW + OpenStax + Wikipedia + arXiv scrapers
body: Build scrapers for remaining sources: NPTEL/SWAYAM (7 course IDs), MIT OCW (6 courses, Archive.org video links), OpenStax (CMS API, K-12 filter), Wikipedia (MediaWiki API, 20 concept articles), arXiv (OAI-PMH, physics.ed-ph).

title: mk-014: Video → Transcript Pipeline (yt-dlp + faster-whisper ONNX)
body: Build video processing pipeline: yt-dlp for download, faster-whisper ONNX for ASR. Output VideoTranscript schema. Integrate with NPTEL, MIT OCW, Khan Academy video content.

title: mk-015: Content Pack Format v1 Implementation (manifest, items, embeddings, signing)
body: Implement Content Pack v1 format: manifest.json, competency_map.json, items/ (content.json, questions.json, variants/, source/), embeddings/ (items.npz). Validation, signing (cosign), license compliance.

title: mk-016: Packager Service (assembly, validation, license compliance, delta packs)
body: Build packager service: assemble Content Packs from enriched items, validate schemas, enforce license compliance (never mix NC/SA), generate delta patches (bsdiff), sign with cosign, upload to CDN.

title: mk-017: Cloud API (FastAPI): Pack generation, competency lookup, sync endpoints
body: Build FastAPI cloud API: POST /packs/generate (on-demand pack creation), GET /competencies/lookup, POST /sync (delta sync), WebSocket for real-time updates. Auth, rate limiting, Kong gateway.

title: mk-018: On-Device Coach Engine (mastery tracking, skill radar, adaptive challenges)
body: Implement PersonalCoach class on-device: analyzeGrowth (skill radar), detectImprovements, generateDailyChallenge, createLearningPlan, generateNarrative. Runs on Phi-3-mini/Gemma-2-2B via ONNX Runtime.

title: mk-019: Multimodal Interaction (Voice STT/TTS, Handwriting canvas, Camera OCR)
body: Implement multimodal components: VoiceRecorder (MediaRecorder + Whisper ONNX), TTSPlayer (Piper/Kokoro), HandwritingCanvas (excalidraw/PencilKit), CameraOCR (MLKit/Tesseract + Phi-3 for math). Integrate with coach.

title: mk-020: Course Player (offline content rendering, progress tracking, coach sidebar)
body: Build course player: offline content rendering (Markdown, LaTeX, diagrams, video), progress tracking per chunk, coach sidebar (hints, explanations, adaptive challenges), bookmark/notes, session persistence.

title: mk-021: Question Generator (fine-tuned on CBSE, Bloom levels, traceability)
body: Fine-tune LLaMA-3.1-8B / Nemotron-3-Ultra on CBSE-aligned QG datasets (SQuAD, RACE, custom). Generate MCQ, short answer, long answer with Bloom levels, difficulty, answer keys, explanations, source chunk traceability.

title: mk-022: Bloom's Taxonomy Tagger (hybrid keyword + LLM)
body: Build BloomTagger: hybrid keyword matching + LLM classification for 6 levels (REMEMBER, UNDERSTAND, APPLY, ANALYZE, EVALUATE, CREATE). Integrate with question generator and content chunk tagging.

title: mk-023: Multimodal Variants (Mermaid diagrams, Manim animations, TTS narration)
body: Build multimodal variant generators: Text→Diagram (Mermaid/excalidraw JSON), Text→Animation (Manim Python), Text→Audio (Piper/Coqui TTS), Video→Summary (ffmpeg + BLIP-2/LLaVA). Output variants/ per content item.

title: mk-024: License Compliance Classifier + Pack License Strategy
body: Build LicenseClassifier: source→license mapping, embedded metadata detection, compatibility matrix enforcement. Pack license strategy: NCERT/KA/MIT OCW → CC-BY-NC-SA; NPTEL/SWAYAM/Wikipedia/OpenStax/DIKSHA → CC-BY-SA/CC-BY. Never mix NC/SA in same pack.

title: mk-025: CBSE Class 9-10 Math/Science Content Pack v1 (build, validate, test)
body: Build first production content pack: CBSE Class 9-10 Mathematics & Science. Run full pipeline: discovery → extraction → enrichment → packaging. Validate schema, license compliance, sign, test on device. Target: 188 items, 2450 chunks, 5640 questions.

title: mk-026: Pilot School Onboarding (10 schools, device profiling, consent)
body: Identify and onboard 10 pilot schools (Tier 2/3 cities). Device profiling (RAM, storage, Android version). Parental consent, data sharing agreements. Teacher training, feedback loops. Target launch: December 31, 2026.

title: mk-027: Coach Insights UI (skill radar, mastery heatmap, improvement narrative)
body: Build coach insights UI: skill radar chart (Recharts), mastery heatmap (calendar + topic grid), improvement narrative cards, weekly learning story, adaptive challenge cards. Tamagui + Recharts.

title: mk-028: Adaptive Challenge Engine (daily challenges, streak logic, motivational coaching)
body: Build adaptive challenge engine: daily challenge generation based on weak areas + spacing + motivation, streak tracking, badge system, motivational coach messages, challenge types (practice, concept, multimodal, reflection). Integrate with coach engine.

title: mk-029: Quality Gate & Release Validation (pre-commit checks, device testing, Telegram notification)
body:
FINAL QUALITY GATE - Runs when all Phase 1-3 tasks complete.

CHECKLIST:
1. **Code Quality**: All tasks have passing tests, linting, type-checking
2. **Device Testing**: App runs on 4GB/6GB/8GB device profiles (emulated + real)
3. **Offline Verification**: Full learning session works 100% offline (tutoring, practice, coach, progress)
4. **Content Pack Validation**: CBSE Class 9-10 Math/Sci pack v1 passes schema, license, device load test
5. **Sync Validation**: Delta sync works (progress ↑, packs ↓) with conflict resolution
6. **Model Performance**: Phi-3-mini/Gemma-2-2B meet latency/memory targets on target devices
7. **Security Audit**: No PII leakage, TLS 1.3, local encryption, DPDP compliance
8. **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA, screen reader, keyboard navigation
9. **Documentation**: All specs updated, API docs, CONTRIBUTING, ARCHITECTURE.md

TELEGRAM NOTIFICATION:
When ALL checks pass, send Telegram to huntingvision (chat_id: 8500700729) with:
- Summary of completed tasks
- Test results (device, offline, sync, model)
- Link to GitHub release / APK / TestFlight
- Any known issues / follow-ups

BLOCKS: All Phase 1-3 tasks (mk-001 through mk-028)

title: Set up launch plan doc and website with user survey for topic collection
body:
**Goal**
Provide a launch plan document and a website with a user survey to capture learning topics and kick off a content generation pipeline.

**Approach**
- Create a launch plan markdown file in the repository outlining objectives, timeline, and responsibilities.
- Design and implement a simple static website (HTML/CSS/JS) hosted in the repo that includes a survey form for users to submit topics they want to learn.
- Connect the survey form to a backend endpoint (e.g., a serverless function or GitHub Actions workflow) that stores submitted topics in a data store (e.g., a JSON file or database) and triggers a content generation pipeline.
- Document how the content generation pipeline will consume the stored topics to produce dedicated learning content.
- Ensure the website and launch plan are version‑controlled and accessible via the repository’s main branch.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Launch plan document exists in the repo (e.g., docs/launch-plan.md) with clear sections for goals, timeline, and roles.
- [ ] Website is present in the repo (e.g., src/ or public/) and builds without errors.
- [ ] Website includes a survey form with fields for user name (optional), email (optional), and topic(s) they want to learn.
- [ ] Submitting the form stores the data in a designated location (e.g., data/topics.json) and triggers a workflow or script that logs the submission.
- [ ] A placeholder content generation pipeline (e.g., a script or workflow) reads the stored topics and outputs a confirmation that content generation would start for each topic.
- [ ] All changes are committed to the main branch and the site can be accessed via the repository’s static site hosting (e.g., GitHub Pages).

**Out of scope**
- Designing advanced analytics or user authentication beyond optional email collection.
- Building a full‑featured CMS or content delivery network; only a placeholder pipeline is required.
- Creating marketing materials beyond the launch plan document.
- Implementing payment processing or monetization features.

title: So in this application on the user side, The gamification could be leveling up, as they go over courses and answer communal questions, engagement points, which actually links to the user progress, and rate user based on the things thwey are good that. Design gamification data model: levels, points, skills, ratings
body: Define the complete data schema for the gamification system. Include: (1) UserLevel table with XP thresholds per level, (2) EngagementPoints ledger with source_type (course_completion, question_answer, streak_bonus, etc.), (3) UserSkillRating table mapping user_id -> skill_tag -> proficiency_score (0-100) with evidence_count, (4) UserInteractionEvent table for raw event logging (event_type, metadata, timestamp). Specify PostgreSQL DDL, indexes for leaderboard queries, and migration strategy. Deliver: SQL migration file + README with entity relationship diagram.

title: Implement user interaction event tracking pipeline
body: Build a lightweight event ingestion service to capture user actions in real time. Requirements: (1) HTTP endpoint `/api/events` accepting JSON {user_id, event_type, metadata, session_id}, (2) Validate against allowed event_types (course_start, lesson_complete, question_submit, question_answer, streak_milestone), (3) Write to UserInteractionEvent table asynchronously via message queue (Redis streams or pg_notify), (4) Batch flush every 500ms or 100 events, (5) Emit Prometheus metrics: events_received_total, events_persisted_total, queue_lag_seconds. Deliver: FastAPI service module, unit tests covering validation and backpressure, Dockerfile.

title: Build engagement points calculation and leveling engine
body: Create the core rules engine that converts raw events into points and level progression. Implement: (1) PointsRules class with configurable weights per event_type (e.g., course_completion=100, correct_answer=10, streak_7d=50), (2) LevelThresholds class loading XP boundaries from config, (3) Function `process_user_events(user_id, since_timestamp)` that aggregates new events, computes delta_points, updates UserLevel and EngagementPoints ledger atomically, (4) Idempotency via event_id deduplication, (5) Unit tests with property-based testing for monotonic XP growth. Deliver: Python module `gamification/engine.py`, pytest suite, config YAML.

title: Design and implement skill rating algorithm
body: Develop a skill inference system that rates users on topical strengths based on their activity. Approach: (1) Define skill taxonomy (tags) mapped to course/question metadata, (2) For each user, collect evidence: correct answers per tag, course completions per tag, time-to-answer, (3) Compute proficiency_score per tag using Bayesian average: (prior_weight * global_avg + evidence_sum) / (prior_weight + evidence_count), (4) Update UserSkillRating table nightly via cron job, (5) Expose `/api/users/{id}/skills` endpoint returning top 10 skills with scores. Deliver: Python module `gamification/skills.py`, nightly job script, API route, integration test.

title: Create gamification API endpoints and frontend widgets
body: Expose the gamification features to the frontend. Build: (1) GET `/api/users/{id}/profile` returning level, total_xp, xp_to_next_level, engagement_points_breakdown, (2) GET `/api/leaderboard?period=week|month|all` returning top 50 users with level and points, (3) React components: LevelBadge, XPProgressBar, SkillTagsCloud, PointsHistoryChart, (4) Integrate into existing user dashboard and course pages, (5) Write Cypress e2e tests for happy paths. Deliver: FastAPI routes, React component library, Storybook stories, e2e test suite.

title: Generate curriculum and content pack on demand from admin dashboard
body:
**Goal**
Enable admins to generate a curriculum, topic, and content pack on demand, with the generated information saved and indexed for reuse.

**Approach**
- Add a "Generate Content" button to the admin dashboard UI.
- Implement a backend service that accepts optional topic/curriculum parameters and uses LLMs or rule‑based logic to produce a curriculum outline and content pack metadata.
- Persist the generated artifacts to the content repository and index them in the search/database for later retrieval.
- Return the generated content pack details to the UI for preview, download, or further editing.
- Handle errors gracefully and provide user‑friendly feedback.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Admin dashboard displays a "Generate Content" button.
- [ ] Clicking the button opens a modal allowing the admin to optionally specify a topic or curriculum parameters.
- [ ] Upon confirmation, the system generates a curriculum outline and content pack metadata within 30 seconds.
- [ ] The generated data is stored in the content repository and indexed for search.
- [ ] Admin can preview, download, or edit the generated content pack from the dashboard.
- [ ] Generation respects supplied parameters; if none are provided, sensible defaults are applied.
- [ ] Errors during generation are caught and displayed as a clear message to the admin.

**Out of scope**
- Automatic publishing of generated content to external learning platforms.
- Modifications to the existing content pack editing or versioning workflow.
- Changes to user authentication, authorization, or role management.
